blurb: Goodwin Park Golf Course offers public golf with an 18-hole South Course, a 9-hole North Course, and a full-length driving range. They provide individual and group golf lessons for all ages and abilities, as well as youth development programming through First Tee - Connecticut. The course also hosts tournaments, outings, and events with full service and amenities.
